description: The two locked 06 v1.1 descriptive analyses not yet run, from the saved EXP-004 HGB predictions (no refit): RQ-4 within-patient IED-type check (06 §2) and results by temporal distance of non-IED epochs from the nearest IED marker (06 §4.2, D3). Found missing 2026-10-21 by the manuscript thread. Both are specified here after RESULT-001 was unblinded; both are descriptive and cannot change any label.
rq4_within_patient: patients evaluable (>= 5 IED and >= 5 non-IED in a state) separately with generalized-only positives and with focal-only positives (05: label 1 generalized, 2-5 focal); difference of the two Delta_p (B2 + FC - B2) within patient; mean over those patients with a 95% patient-cluster percentile bootstrap; per-patient values; no label
distance_definition: seconds from the nearest IED marker (point '!' or run '!start'..'!end') to the closer edge of the 4-s epoch; 0 if a marker falls inside; kept non-IED epochs only (adjacent epochs stay excluded as in the primary set)
distance_bins_status: PROPOSED default on the decision card of 2026-10-21; replaced by Josue's choice before freezing
distance_metric: per bin: negatives restricted to the bin, all IED epochs kept, evaluability recomputed; B2 + FC - B2 as estimate + 95% percentile bootstrap (R10, no label); mean within-patient AUROC of B2; patients and negatives per bin
